recognize_zh: 這是示意長條圖而非形態圖：上排代表唐氏症（DS）新生兒中僅一小部分發生 TAM，中排代表 TAM 病人中一部分後來進展為唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病（ML-DS），下方標示其中 70% 為急性巨核母細胞白血病（AMKL）。
features: Schematic horizontal bar diagram, not a morphologic image
Top bar: Down syndrome (DS) population with a small terminal segment labeled TAM
Middle bar: TAM population expanded, with a segment labeled ML-DS (myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome)
Bottom box under ML-DS: '70% are AMKL' (acute megakaryoblastic leukemia)
Bars illustrate nested proportions and are not drawn to exact scale
describe_en: This figure is a schematic summary rather than a morphologic image. It shows that transient abnormal myelopoiesis (TAM) arises in a minority of neonates with Down syndrome, that a subset of patients with TAM later develop myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS), and that about 70% of ML-DS cases are acute megakaryoblastic leukemia. It should be interpreted as a conceptual illustration of the natural history (TAM, often spontaneously regressing, followed in some patients by ML-DS within the first years of life) rather than a precise quantitative graph.
